lineup: Chúpame El Dedo — Eblis Álvarez and Pedro Ojeda

events.factual_description: Rhizome DC and Secret Planet present Chúpame El Dedo with Abismo Ónix on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 at 7:00 PM. Rhizome identifies Chúpame El Dedo as the Colombian duo of Eblis Álvarez of Meridian Brothers and Pedro Ojeda of Ondatrópica, describing a deliberate collision of traditional Colombian music, metal, grindcore, distorted vocals, electronic/gabber-like elements and tropical rhythm vocabularies including salsa, cumbia, currulao and reggaeton. Richmond-based Abismo Ónix is billed as a bachata-metal band, with live members Andrés Bass on vocals, Moises Carrillo on drums/bongos, Alfonso Santos on guitar and Ramm Iyer on bass. Rhizome lists a $20 face price; authorized Pools ticketing currently shows $22.47 including fees.

en.why_it_matters: This is almost a diagram of several Listening Notes threads colliding on one small stage: Eblis Álvarez and Pedro Ojeda push Colombian rhythmic languages through distortion, machines, grindcore and metallic abrasion, then Abismo Ónix answers from Richmond by forcing bachata into a heavy-band frame. The attraction is not genre novelty for its own sake; it is the physical argument between groove and extremity, with Latin rhythm remaining audible inside the noise.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this one if you are in the DMV. Rhizome is exactly the right scale for a collision this strange and rhythmic, and I would choose it over a more replaceable local club night; there is no reason to turn it into a corridor trip from outside the region.

es.why_it_matters: Esta noche parece un diagrama de varios hilos de Listening Notes chocando en el mismo escenario: Eblis Álvarez y Pedro Ojeda empujan lenguajes rítmicos colombianos hacia distorsión, máquinas, grindcore y abrasión metálica; después Abismo Ónix responde desde Richmond metiendo bachata en una formación pesada. La gracia no es la rareza de género por sí misma, sino la pelea física entre groove y extremidad, con el pulso latino todavía reconocible dentro del ruido.
es.trip_verdict: Si estás en el DMV, sí le haría espacio activamente. Rhizome tiene la escala exacta para una colisión así de rara y rítmica, y la escogería por encima de una noche local más reemplazable; no la convertiría en un viaje regional desde fuera del corredor.
